summary: Treat Hostex's HTTP-200 response envelope error_code (>=400) as a typed error with 429/5xx retry, instead of trusting HTTP status.
reason: Hostex returns HTTP 200 for every call and puts the real status in error_code (200=success). The generated client treats HTTP 200 as success, so application errors were silent successes and rate-limit retries never fired. A 5xx error_code on a write is not replayed, matching the generator's ambiguous-write rule.
validated_outcome: TestHostexErrorCodeEnvelope and TestHostexEnvelope5xxDoesNotReplayWrites pass; live read-only sync 23/23 and real 4xx surface as non-zero exit on the 4.33.0 reprint.
